about: What this member said on the floor, from the Congressional Record: their own words only, and of those the sentences that name an alignment question's phrases or make a commitment. Written by npm run record:collect (scripts/collect-record.mjs).
name: Jay Obernolte

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PREVENTIVE HEALTH SAVINGS ACT
statements.title: PREVENTIVE HEALTH SAVINGS ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise in support of my bipartisan legislation, the Preventive Health Savings Act, and I, too, would like to thank my colleagues, Representatives Diana DeGette, Buddy Carter, and Scott Peters, for joining me on this bill.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to support the Preventive Health Savings Act.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: YUHAAVIATAM OF SAN MANUEL NATION LAND EXCHANGE ACT
statements.title: YUHAAVIATAM OF SAN MANUEL NATION LAND EXCHANGE ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise today in support of my bill, H.R. 3925, the Yuhaaviatam of San Manuel Nation Land Exchange Act.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to support H.R. 3925.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: AIRSPACE LOCATION AND ENHANCED RISK TRANSPARENCY ACT OF 2026
statements.title: AIRSPACE LOCATION AND ENHANCED RISK TRANSPARENCY ACT OF 2026
sentences: Madam Speaker, I rise in strong support of the ALERT Act.
I urge my colleagues to support this bill.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ROTORCRAFT OPERATIONS TRANSPARENCY AND OVERSIGHT REFORM ACT
statements.title: ROTORCRAFT OPERATIONS TRANSPARENCY AND OVERSIGHT REFORM ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I urge us to reject the ROTOR Act today and to quickly pass the ALERT Act, conference those changes with the Senate, and get it on the President's desk for signature.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: VETERANS READINESS AND EMPLOYMENT IMPROVEMENT ACT OF 2025
statements.title: VETERANS READINESS AND EMPLOYMENT IMPROVEMENT ACT OF 2025
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise in strong support of H.R. 980.
Mr. Speaker, I urge all of my colleagues to vote ``yes'' on H.R. 980.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: IN REMEMBRANCE OF THE HONORABLE DOUG LaMALFA
statements.title: IN REMEMBRANCE OF THE HONORABLE DOUG LaMALFA
sentences: I will miss his service there.
I will also miss the man that he was.
Above all, Mr. Speaker, I will miss my friend.
I will miss our conversations about cars.
Above all, I will miss our conversations.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: MIKAELA NAYLON GIVE KIDS A CHANCE ACT
statements.title: MIKAELA NAYLON GIVE KIDS A CHANCE ACT
sentences: The Give Kids a Chance Act will reauthorize the FDA's Priority Review Voucher system to speed the research and development of these technologies and innovative treatments and bring them to market.
Mr. Speaker, I rise in strong support as both a member of the Health Subcommittee and a proud cosponsor of this bill, H.R. 1262, the Give Kids a Chance Act.
I urge this body to pass it this evening and urge its speedy consideration in the Senate.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 3838, STREAMLINING PROCUREMENT FOR EFFECTIVE EXECUTION AND DELIVERY AND NATIONAL DEFENSE AUTHORIZATION ACT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2026;
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 3838, STREAMLINING PROCUREMENT FOR EFFECTIVE EXECUTION AND DELIVERY AND NATIONAL DEFENSE AUTHORIZATION ACT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2026; AND PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION...
sentences: Among the five military bases that I represent is the Marine Corps Air Ground Combat Center in Twentynine Palms.
Mr. Speaker, I urge adoption of my amendment and that it be made in order to solve this problem.
Recently, the Marine Corps has proposed to expand the scale of operations and training at that base, which I fully support.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: NTIA POLICY AND CYBERSECURITY COORDINATION ACT
statements.title: NTIA POLICY AND CYBERSECURITY COORDINATION ACT
sentences: That is why it is critical that we establish cybersecurity protocols and capabilities to counter the threats not just of foreign actors but of cybercriminals and transnational criminal organizations who attempt to breach our data security and access the data of Americans.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: HALT ALL LETHAL TRAFFICKING OF FENTANYL ACT
statements.title: HALT ALL LETHAL TRAFFICKING OF FENTANYL ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise in strong support of S. 331, the HALT Fentanyl Act.
We must give our law enforcement the tools to combat this problem.
It permanently reschedules fentanyl and its analogues as a schedule I narcotic, and it gives our law enforcement agencies the tools that they need to begin dealing with this problem.
That is why I am proud to be a cosponsor of the House version of this legislation, and I urge my colleagues to vote in support of it.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SUPPORT FOR PATIENTS AND COMMUNITIES REAUTHORIZATION ACT OF 2025
statements.title: SUPPORT FOR PATIENTS AND COMMUNITIES REAUTHORIZATION ACT OF 2025
sentences: It provides 24/7 crisis mental health counseling to Americans that are facing mental health crises and are in danger of committing suicide.
My bill will solve that problem by improving information sharing between law enforcement agencies and the operators of the lifeline, which will keep that lifeline up for the people who need it.
Mr. Chair, I rise in strong support of this bipartisan bill that reauthorizes the SUPPORT for Patients and Communities Act programs from 2018.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING CONGRESSIONAL DISAPPROVAL OF THE RULE SUBMITTED BY THE ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION AGENCY RELATING TO "CALIFORNIA STATE MOTOR VEHICLE AND ENGINE AND NONROAD
statements.title: PROVIDING CONGRESSIONAL DISAPPROVAL OF THE RULE SUBMITTED BY THE ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION AGENCY RELATING TO "CALIFORNIA STATE MOTOR VEHICLE AND ENGINE AND NONROAD ENGINE POLLUTION CONTROL...
sentences: To be clear, I am not an opponent of electric vehicles, and I consider myself an environmentalist, but I feel strongly that my constituents ought to have the ability to buy for themselves the vehicle that will best meet their needs.
For some of them, that is an electric vehicle.
Also, let's be clear about this: If it were more efficient or less expensive to deliver using zero-emissions trucks, these companies would already be doing it, but the truth is it absolutely is not.
By forcing this choice on California consumers, we will also be forcing on them all of the concomitant increases in the prices of the goods that they buy every day.

I believe this body is entirely appropriate in taking this action today, and I strongly urge my colleagues to vote ``yes'' on this resolution, H.J. Res. 89, and the other Congressional Review Act actions we are taking today.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: COST-SHARE ACCOUNTABILITY ACT OF 2025
statements.title: COST-SHARE ACCOUNTABILITY ACT OF 2025
sentences: That is important because it makes sure that the entity that the grant is awarded to has some skin in the game, and it also ensures the taxpayers get the best value for their dollar when that grant is performed.
Mr. Speaker, this is transparent, bipartisan, good government legislation, and I urge my colleagues to vote ``yes.''

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CONCURRENT RESOLUTION ON THE BUDGET FOR FISCAL YEAR 2025
statements.title: CONCURRENT RESOLUTION ON THE BUDGET FOR FISCAL YEAR 2025
sentences: Mr. Chair, this year we will borrow almost $2 trillion, which represents almost a third of all Federal spending.

For the first time in the history of our country, this year we will spend more on interest paying the national debt that we have already borrowed, and in several years three-quarters of all Federal spending, borrowing, will be just to pay interest on the money that we have already borrowed.
Several years after that, we won't even have enough money to pay the interest on the national debt, which will signal a devastating default for our country.
It starts us, finally, down the path of reducing Federal spending rather than increasing Federal spending, and it does it without increasing taxes on hardworking Americans.
Mr. Chair, we cannot allow that to happen.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: HALT ALL LETHAL TRAFFICKING OF FENTANYL ACT
statements.title: HALT ALL LETHAL TRAFFICKING OF FENTANYL ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I rise in strong support of H.R. 27, the HALT Fentanyl Act.

This bill would permanently classify fentanyl and its analogues as schedule I controlled substances, which will give our law enforcement officers more tools to use in tracking down and stopping the dealers who are trafficking this substance into our communities.
This bill would give our law enforcement agencies more tools to help stop this problem.
That is why I am proud to be a cosponsor of it, and I strongly urge its passage.
